scripts/generate_proxmox_api.py

Python · Tier B

Compile the pinned Proxmox API Viewer JSON literal into offline tool descriptors.

Usage

Run from any directory; --check verifies deterministic generated bytes without replacing them.

Inputs

--source selects the official viewer bytes or gzip; --provenance supplies the reviewed source digest and release evidence; --output selects the generated directory.

Side effects

Generation writes endpoints, sections and source_manifest JSON and reports removed method/path identities. Check mode may create the requested output directory. No network fetch, JavaScript execution, login or remote API operation occurs.

Cleanup

The process owns no services or credentials. Review and retain the generated JSON and pinned source together; temporary source acquisition is the maintainer's responsibility.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
extract 37 @brief Decode the official apiSchema JSON assignment without evaluating JavaScript; reject a non-list or missing terminator.
normalized 50 @brief Build a lowercase identifier component from vendor path text; callers handle normalization collisions.
optional 56 @brief Honor explicit optional metadata, otherwise require every union branch to permit omission.
tool_id 65 @brief Derive a stable method/path identity, adding a digest whenever normalization is lossy or too long.
schema 77 Translate PVE optional/type-property and composed object schemas to JSON Schema. PVE property-string formats stay strings. Their vendor format metadata is kept in the descriptor's source schema; it is not a JSON Schema format checker.
generate 148 @brief Verify reviewed source digest/version evidence and account for every method in deterministic endpoint, section and manifest documents; reject identity collisions.
main 239 @brief Read only local source/provenance, regenerate files or fail on --check drift, and print the provenance manifest. Output writes are limited to --output.
